sources.title: gatilin/mistral-large-4-vision-encoder · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This component does not include the language model. The checkpoint preserves original tensor names, shapes and BF16 values: vision_encoder.*, pre_mm_projector_norm.*, patch_merger.* and vision_language_adapter.*. The 30-layer Pixtral-style vision tower has hidden size 2048, 16 attention heads, patch size 14, and axial 2-D rotary positions.

sources.title: Mistral Large 4 - Mistral AI | Mistral Docs
sources.snippet: Mistral Large 4 is a state-of-the-art, open-weight, general-purpose multimodal model with a granular Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It features 52B active parameters and 1.05T total parameters, and a 1.6B vision encoder.
